# Mira story map

## Released

- S1 A shop owner sees today's report on the kiosk.

## Next release

- S2 A shop owner downloads the report as a CSV file.

## Deferred (not in the release plan)

- S9 A shop owner invites a second manager.
- S10 A shop prints a QR code on each receipt so customers can leave a review. Idea only: not this release and not soon. Not designed; when picked up, check receipts-at-most-40-characters-per-line (ADR 0023) and whether a review request counts as a new kind of customer message (decision log ADR 0009).
